stem: Voltmarkt compares store sales in October 2025 with October 2024. Its rule: a store counts in LFL only when it opened at least 12 full months before the first day of the same month last year, is still open, and had sales in both months. The 22 stores that opened before 2023 took €7.50 million in October 2024 and €7.80 million in October 2025. Almere, opened on 1 September 2024, took €0.20 million and €0.32 million. Mechelen, opened on 1 March 2025, took €0.26 million in October 2025. Zwolle, closed on 30 June 2025, took €0.25 million in October 2024. What is the LFL sales growth for October 2025? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
